transcript.msg: What led you to send this one to enhanced review, and what would have changed your mind?
The largest owner holds 35% and isn't verified. Anything over 25% that isn't verified goes to enhanced review, and so does a company registry extract older than six months.
If the entity type were "individual" instead of company, with the largest beneficial owner share still at 100%, what would you decide?
If the largest owner holds more than 25% and isn't verified, it goes to enhanced review.
What told you to approve onboarding here, and what would have changed your mind?

Country risk alone, isn't it? A long relationship with verified funds lets me approve high-risk customers. But never approve a customer from a high-risk country at desk level unless they've banked with us for two years with verified funds.
You mentioned "Company registry extract age (months)". What counts as that, and where would I see it on screen?
It's what the case file shows in that section. On its own, it didn't change this decision.
What pointed you toward escalating to the compliance officer here, and what would have changed your mind?
She's a politically exposed person, so it goes to the compliance officer.
Never approve a politically exposed person without compliance sign-off.
